svg.title: Spot the Red Flags
svg.desc: A mock Claude-drafted article with its red flags marked: an unsupplied statistic and an unsourced quote as possible hallucinations, two launch dates that disagree as an inconsistency, and wording that assumes engineers are men as bias; asking Claude how confident it is does not count as a check.
svg.text: Specific-looking details are where errors hide.
The Safe Hands programme cut site incidents by 37% in its first year.
"Safety is our first value," said the chief executive at the launch.
quote not in the notes: check
Training starts on 4 March for all engineers and their wives' support network.
From 11 March, every site will run the new checks.
Check each flag against the source
Ask Claude how confident it is
